title: 实现首位管理员引导与带外恢复核心
changed_contracts: Adds internal GatewayAuth administrator bootstrap/recovery action, outcome, result, proof, verifier and store contracts; no public wire API, SDK or Host route is added.
Adds production migration 12 with one no-secret idempotency table, one owner-only request matching helper, and two runtime-executable SECURITY DEFINER mutations.
Advances the exact production database readiness contract from migration 11 to migration 12 while preserving PostgreSQL 16.15 and the existing role graph.
risks: This is component-only: no real out-of-band authorization verifier, deployment secret lifecycle, operator entry point or Host composition exists, so it must not be exposed as a deployable recovery channel.
Future composition still requires TLS, persistent keys, secure Cookie/Origin/CSRF behavior, operator identity, upstream abuse control and end-to-end negative tests.
The global advisory lock intentionally serializes low-frequency emergency administrator mutations; it must not be reused for bulk account management.
GitHub-hosted Linux CI did not run; local evidence is Windows with .NET 10.0.111 and PostgreSQL 16.15.

architecture_review.module: GatewayAuth administrator bootstrap and out-of-band recovery core
reused_existing_logic: Reuses V01-012 LocalSecret, enrollment length policy, ILocalSecretRiskChecker, ILocalCredentialDeriver, PBKDF2 enrollment material and account state contracts.
Reuses PostgresAuthenticationExecutor, the GatewayAuth runtime role, local principal/credential/session tables and credential/session version invalidation semantics.
Extracts same-module PostgreSQL parameter and account-state readers so lifecycle and administrator stores share the existing representation without cross-module helpers.
cross_module_access: All new production code remains inside GatewayAuth; Infrastructure implements Application-owned ports and Application depends only on GatewayAuth contracts.
Migration 12 creates and mutates only gateway_auth-owned objects and does not access asset files, other module tables or mutable globals outside the approved advisory lock.
No Host, public API, generated SDK, dependency lock, filesystem adapter or other module internal implementation changed.
contract_changes: Introduces an internal authorization binding and fail-closed outcome model for administrator bootstrap/recovery.
Introduces migration 12 with dual-ID replay protection, transaction-time authorization expiry and database-owned administrator fact checks.
Keeps production authentication, business API, database composition, file writes and all release targets blocked.
architecture_tests: Locked restore, format verification, zero-warning Release build and all 257 .NET tests passed; WebGateway is 73/73.
All 67 database, 54 repository, 14 architecture and 32 release tests passed, including real PostgreSQL 16.15 concurrency, restart, least privilege and C# adapter round trip.
Repository, server-release and Alpha validators passed; v0.1-start is allowed while Alpha --require-ready and v0.1-release retain native exit code 3.
technical_debt: Implement a real rotatable and auditable out-of-band verifier plus deployment secret lifecycle before creating any operator entry point.
Compose GatewayAuth with PostgreSQL and an authenticated read-only Host only after TLS, persistent keys, Cookie/Origin/CSRF and abuse controls are verified.
Keep every production file-write and release target disabled until its existing durability and platform evidence gates close.
